name: Fact Spear
description: Throw a spear of one plain fact that goes straight through a shield raised on a falsehood.

name: Glamour Break
description: Break a charm or glamour on a foe with a clear note that rings through his sense.

name: Host Reading
description: Read the number and the nerve and the true purpose of a whole body of foes.

name: Clear Bulwark
description: Set a clear bulwark before the user that no deceit or false aim can find a way round.

name: Sundering Wave
description: Send out a wave of plain fact that breaks every illusion and every guard built on one.

name: Falsehood Crush
description: Press a host to the ground under the weight of the one fact its cause is built on denying.

name: Veracity Lance
description: Drive a long lance of veracity through a rank of foes to the chief who stands behind them.

name: Unmasking Tide
description: Wash a tide of clear qi over a whole front and strip every disguise as it passes.

name: Bare Reality
description: Cancel every illusion and false shape across the qi field and leave only what is there.

name: Fact Breaker
description: Break a foe on the one fact that he has refused to face and no guard can hold against it.

name: Allseeing Eye
description: Open the sense to the full reach of the field and see all that is true there at once.

name: Bare Decree
description: Speak a decree of one plain fact and strike so the foe is held by it and broken.

name: Sundered Pretence
description: Break every pretence on the field to the destructive ceiling of the caster's tier and ruin all that stood on them.

name: Fact Cataclysm
description: Drop one plain fact on the whole host with the full reach of the tier and leave nothing of its cover.

name: Liar Mark
description: Mark each speaker on the field whose words and qi part ways and follow them by sense.

name: Hidden Dragging
description: Drag a hidden foe from his cover into plain view by a pull of clear qi.

name: Core Candour
description: Open the core wholly and let its clear qi drive every limb with no hesitation.

name: Clear Barrier
description: Stand a plain barrier of clear qi from the core that turns blades and false aims alike.

name: Revealing Surge
description: Surge clear qi across the ground and strike every foe it drags out of hiding.

name: Truth Weight
description: Lay the full weight of what is so on a group until their lies can no longer bear their stance.

name: Exact Annulment
description: Seal a single false technique shut at its root so it cannot be cast again that day.

name: Core Verity
description: Throw the whole verity of the core into one blow that lands on the foe's true centre.

name: Liarless Ban
description: Hold a field in which no illusion or glamour can take shape for as long as it is held.

name: Veil Annihilation
description: Annihilate every veil and disguise on the ground in one bright pulse of the qi field.

name: Account Rendered
description: Render the foe's whole account through the field and strike at its sum past all guard.

name: Absolute Candor
description: Stand wholly open and strike with nothing held back so that no guard can claim surprise.

name: Verity Throne
description: Sit upon a seat of verity that holds foes down and sends back every lie spoken at it.

name: Reckoning Cataclysm
description: Call the final reckoning over the field to the destructive ceiling of the caster's tier and break all that is false in it.

name: Unlied Earth
description: Strip the earth of every lie to the full reach of the tier until the whole ground rings with the strike.
